connector.name: web3agent
connector.registryDescription: Web3 MCP proxy for AI agents: DeFi swaps, bridges, market data, wallets, and gated writes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package web3agent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the apegurus account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CHAIN_ID
env.description: Default EVM chain ID. Defaults to Base mainnet (8453).

env.name: CONFIRM_WRITES
env.description: Require explicit confirmation before write operations execute. Defaults to true.

env.name: ETHERSCAN_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Etherscan API key for Etherscan-backed explorer tools.

env.name: ZEROX_API_KEY
env.description: Optional 0x API key for 0x swap plugin support.

env.name: COINGECKO_API_KEY
env.description: Optional CoinGecko API key for higher-rate market data.

env.name: CCXT_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Optional local path to a CCXT account config JSON file.

env.name: OWS_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Optional Open Wallet Standard vault passphrase for persisted local wallets.
